tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Entwickler | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend specialist with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, full-stack integration of PIM, ERP and MDM, and performance-focused architecture. Proven record in CI/CD, DevOps, code reviews, and techno-functional consulting with international teams, driving stable, scalable e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Entwickler SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Leuchtmehr’s ambition to shape the technical future of a global e-commerce platform. With more than five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have repeatedly delivered scalable, high-performance solutions that align perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: **Technical Leadership**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I led the design and implementation of backend services on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, guiding both internal and offshore developers and establishing coding standards.

bullets.label: **Full-Stack Integration**
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM data pipelines, ensuring seamless product-catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: **Architecture & Performance**
bullets.text: Architected API migrations and refactored database queries, improving system stability and reducing response latency, while conducting code reviews to enforce high quality.

bullets.label: **Agile Delivery & CI/CD**
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) and coordinated releases with international teams, supporting production and continuous improvement.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Leuchtmehr’s success.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Entwickler SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Leuchtmehrs Ziel, die technische Zukunft einer globalen E-Commerce-Plattform zu gestalten, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der SAP Commerce Cloud-Entwicklung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich wiederholt skalierbare, leistungsstarke Lösungen geliefert, die exakt zu Ihrer Vision passen.

bullets.label: **Technische Führung**
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation leitete ich das Design und die Implementierung von Backend-Services auf SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, koordinierte interne und externe Entwicklerteams und etablierte Coding-Standards.

bullets.label: **Full-Stack Integration**
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Webservices und integrierte PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Datenpipelines, um eine nahtlose Produktsynchronisation über globale Kanäle sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: **Architektur & Performance**
bullets.text: Ich konzipierte API-Migrationen und optimierte Datenbankabfragen, wodurch Systemstabilität und Antwortzeiten verbessert wurden, und führte Code-Reviews zur Sicherstellung hoher Qualität durch.

bullets.label: **Agile Lieferung & CI/CD**
bullets.text: Ich führte CI/CD-Deployments im SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) durch und koordinierte Releases mit internationalen Teams, unterstützte den Produktivbetrieb und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist (frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026). Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zum Erfolg von Leuchtmehr zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Leuchtmehr GmbH stands out as a forward-thinking manufacturing leader that invests heavily in a global e-commerce ecosystem. Your focus on modern software architectures, international rollouts and continuous innovation aligns perfectly with my experience driving SAP Commerce Cloud transformations for global brands. I am eager to apply my technical leadership and integration expertise to help Leuchtmehr deliver a resilient, high-performance platform that supports its worldwide growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Leuchtmehr to shape a global e-commerce platform with cutting-edge SAP Commerce Cloud architecture, leveraging my proven leadership and integration experience to drive performance and innovation.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about Leuchtmehr’s global e-commerce vision and would love to discuss how I can contribute. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Entwickler SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d) – Leuchtmehr GmbH
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Entwickler SAP Commerce Cloud position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to Leuchtmehr. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.

Best regards
